name: vscode-noriscript
description: NoriScript language support via Volar TS plugin plus syntax highlighting for NoriScript-specific tokens.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:noriscript && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:server-assets && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run build:vendor
scripts.build:server: rm -rf ./out && mkdir -p ./out && ESBUILD_BIN=$(ls ../../node_modules/.pnpm/esbuild@*/node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild | head -n1) && "$ESBUILD_BIN" ../volar-noriscript/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __rueCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __rueCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=./out/noriscript-language-server.mjs
scripts.build:server-assets: mkdir -p ./out/beautify ./out/data ./out/languageFacts ./out/parser ./out/services ./out/utils ./out/node_modules/@vscode ./out/node_modules/@oxc-parser && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/cssLanguageTypes.js ./out/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/beautify/*.js ./out/beautify/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/data/*.js ./out/data/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/languageFacts/*.js ./out/languageFacts/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/parser/*.js ./out/parser/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/services/*.js ./out/services/ && cp ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-css-languageservice@*/node_modules/vscode-css-languageservice/lib/umd/utils/*.js ./out/utils/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/@vscode+l10n@*/node_modules/@vscode/l10n ./out/node_modules/@vscode/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-uri@*/node_modules/vscode-uri ./out/node_modules/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-languageserver-textdocument@*/node_modules/vscode-languageserver-textdocument ./out/node_modules/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-languageserver-types@*/node_modules/vscode-languageserver-types ./out/node_modules/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/@oxc-parser+binding-darwin-arm64@*/node_modules/@oxc-parser/binding-darwin-arm64 ./out/node_modules/@oxc-parser/
scripts.build:vendor: rm -rf ./vendor_node_modules && mkdir -p ./vendor_node_modules/@oxc-parser ./vendor_node_modules/@vscode && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/@oxc-parser+binding-darwin-arm64@*/node_modules/@oxc-parser/binding-darwin-arm64 ./vendor_node_modules/@oxc-parser/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/@vscode+l10n@*/node_modules/@vscode/l10n ./vendor_node_modules/@vscode/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-uri@*/node_modules/vscode-uri ./vendor_node_modules/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-languageserver-textdocument@*/node_modules/vscode-languageserver-textdocument ./vendor_node_modules/ && cp -R ../../node_modules/.pnpm/vscode-languageserver-types@*/node_modules/vscode-languageserver-types ./vendor_node_modules/
scripts.vsix: pnpm run build && pnpm exec vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out ./vscode-noriscript.vsix

semanticTokenTypes.description: The @ getter-access operator in NoriScript syntax.
